description:
A swipeable stack of room photos for exploring decorating styles. Pass `ids`, the inspiration ids to show in stacking order. Each photo and title comes from a built-in catalogue, so no search or URLs are needed; unknown ids are skipped. Three to five photos work best.

Available ids:
- 4Vz4QDOsgakAfoXAfDci — Scandinavian (bright, cream linen, pale oak, blush/sage/dusty-blue)
- 6CbhV4PNBSz5EHjVD1CT — Minimalist (Japandi, ivory, light oak, boucle)
- GiOJSEGechQgSMx9Ued3 — Warm Contemporary (cream + warm brown, oak pedestal, pampas)
- QZA7vy7hvJP56VJO7Y1h — Modern (soft neutral, cream sofa, beige rug)
- S1lMVQsgG3BL3RdGps3F — Coastal Hamptons (ivory slipcover, blue stripes, jute, shiplap)
- TLhFIONJsGwqLMBNEq2j — Art Deco (emerald + navy velvet, brass, geometric)
- UVKVosxVJ5x4461MtAgN — Classic (cream linen, black steel, olive greens)
- VeFfSlpEgl2uSnnXFOZ2 — Coastal (pale grey + soft blue, stone, palm)
- rkI86R371Wgnz00iowUS — Mid Century Modern (boucle + tan leather, walnut, teal/rust kilim)
- tZ7eisSDBTOkaPtES1v0 — Contemporary (sleek L-shape, glass + chrome, ochre/navy accents)
